This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. (483 Bnss) has been filed by
the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.174/2023 registered at Police
Station Ladnun, Dist. Deedwana, for the offences under Sections 376(2)
(n) of Ipc.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner- Suresh Gurjar on 12.06.2023,
lodged an FIR No.169/2023 at P.S. Ladnun, for the offences under Sections 341, 323, 420, 406,
506/34 of IPC against the prosecutrix 'G' alleging inter alia that about 18 months prior to the date of lodging of the [2024:RJ-JD:51266] (2 of 4) [CRLMB-13902/2024] aforesaid FIR, he had sold a Toyota Etios car having registration No.RJ14-TB-9747 and Maruti Swift Dezire car having registration No.RJ43-CA-1449 to the prosecutrix and her husband- Vipul Sharma.

These cars were Suresh Gurjar vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:51266) on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/54831029/

sentences.text: In the aforesaid FIR, it was further alleged that on 11.06.2023, accused came to her house and instead of giving him due amount, demanded a sum of Rs.10,00,000/- from him.
He was threatened that if the demand is not fulfilled, then he would be implicated in a false criminal case of rape.

Learned counsel submitted that the police after making thorough investigation in connection with FIR No.169/2023 has submitted challan papers before the competent criminal Court against the prosecutrix and her husband.

Learned counsel submitted that after lodging of the FIR No.169/2023 dated 12.06.2023, the prosecutrix has submitted a written complaint before SHO, PS Ladnun, alleging inter alia that on 21.04.2024, when she boarded a bus from Ladnun to Deedwana, she received a call from the one Nauratan Chouhan telling her to accompany him on his motorbike as she is being called by the present petitioner.
Upon this, she stepped out of the car and accompanied him on his motorbike.
As per the prosecutrix, she was thereupon subjected to forcible sexual assault/rape by him.
Learned counsel submitted that the material available on record clearly indicate that the petitioner has been falsely [2024:RJ-JD:51266] (3 of 4) [CRLMB-13902/2024] implicated in the present case.
The specific allegation of forcible sexual assault/rape has been levelled by the prosecutrix against Nauratan Chouhan.

Lastly, learned counsel submitted that the petitioner is in judicial custody; the investigation against the petitioner has already been concluded and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time,
therefore, the benefit of bail may be granted to the accused-petitioner.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor has vehemently opposed the bail application.

Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case and having perused the case diary so also the challan submitted by the investigating agency in relation to FIR No.169/2023 registered at P.S. Ladnun, this Court prima facie finds that the petitioner and complainant are having old acquaintance and some financial disputes; the prosecutrix has been charge-sheeted for the offences under Sections 341, 323, 420, 506/34 of IPC in relation to FIR No.169/2023; the specific allegation of she being subjected to forcible sexual assault/rape on 21.04.2024 has been levelled against one Nauratan Chouhan and the investigation against the petitioner has already been concluded.

This Court also prima facie finds that the prosecution has not shown any apprehension of petitioner influencing the material prosecution witnesses of the case or fleeing away from justice or tampering with the evidence, in case he is enlarged on bail.

Thus,
without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
[2024:RJ-JD:51266] (4 of 4) [CRLMB-13902/2024] Consequently, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C (483 BNSS) is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-petitioner Suresh Gurjar S/o Lt. Shri Hanuman Gurjar arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.174/2023 registered at Police Suresh Gurjar vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:51266) on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/54831029/
